text:
lisa.chen: Hey team — customer asked for SIG Q-by-Q crosswalk + artifacts. I attached the draft mapping in Drive: https://drive.company/redwood/sig-crosswalk (permissions: sales-read). Can folks confirm which artifacts they can provide by EOD?
omar.patel: Taking application architecture diagrams + network segmentation doc. Will upload PDFs. Any naming convention?
jordan.kim: I can do infra configs and IAM screenshots. I'll need a list of exact control IDs so I can match folders to the spreadsheet rows.
lisa.chen: Good call — see tab 'control_map' in the sheet, column C has SIG control IDs. Use that as filenames: e.g., SIG_A.1_network-segmentation.pdf
marie.vazquez: Heads-up: some screenshots include internal hostnames. We should scrub or provide redacted versions. Security wants to avoid live hostnames in artifacts.
sig-bot: Reminder: upload artifacts to the secure S3 bucket only. Use this presigned form: https://upload.redwood-secure/sig-uploads. Files >10MB should be split or archived.
omar.patel: Got it. I'll create redacted and original copies and put redacted in the public folder, originals in secure bucket with access log.
jordan.kim: ETA for my uploads: tomorrow morning PST. Marie — can you run redaction script for screenshots? I can handoff raw images.
marie.vazquez: Yep — will run redaction and add a short CSV mapping raw->redacted filenames. Also will note any evidence we can't produce and why (third-party host info).
lisa.chen: Perfect. I'll ping the customer to set expectation that artifacts come in by EOD tomorrow. Action items: Omar (app diagrams + network seg) | Jordan (infra configs + IAM screenshots) | Marie (redaction + mapping CSV). I'll update the sheet with status. :thumbsup: 
sig-bot: Checklist status updated: artifacts_requested -> 12, artifacts_received -> 0, next_reminder -> 1739529600.
